FIELD MANUAL / MOVEMENT IS YOUR WEAPON

Trust the arm.

You cannot jump. Aim at a cyan grapple point, attach, then climb or swing. The highlighted diamond shows the point your next shot will catch.

A D / ← → · D-pad / left stick
K Z Space · pad A / right trigger
W / ↑ · stick up
S / ↓ · stick down
J / X · pad X / left trigger
E / Enter · pad Y
Q / C · pad B
Esc / P · pad Start

On a tether: left and right pump your swing; up reels in and pulls you onto the ledge. Tap the arm button to release with your momentum. Down drops you. On the ground, down + arm fires horizontally to stun a guard or retrieve supplies. A latched arm can block hostile shots along its cable.

Keep moving: enemies flash before firing. Crouch beneath rifle fire, collect their bullet capsules to increase maximum vitality, and use pills with Q. Amber-striped supports are solid; water and spike beds are lethal. Checkpoints restore you on defeat.

Touch: use the visible D-pad and ARM / FIRE / USE / HEAL buttons. Landscape gives you the widest view. Mouse left fires; mouse right uses the directional arm, not cursor aiming.
